description: Same as open_in_mindmax_write (or request_review_with_mindmax with review: true), but reads a Markdown file you already saved in the workspace (.md, .markdown, .mdx, .txt). Prefer this when the document is in a file — it avoids repeating the whole text. Show the returned link verbatim.

title.description: Document title; defaults to the first heading

excerpt.description: Plain-text opening of the document, for previews
